blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Neural synchrony is hypothesized to help the brain organize visual scenes into structured multi-object representations. In machine learning, synchrony-based models analogously learn object-centric representations by storing binding in the phase of complex-valued features. Rotating Features (RF) instantiate this idea with vector-valued activations, encoding object presence in magnitudes and affiliation in orientations. We propose Orthogonal Rotating Features (OrthoRF), which enforces orthogonality in RF's orientation space via an inner-product loss and architectural modifications. This yields sharper phase alignment and more reliable grouping. In evaluations of unsupervised object discovery, including settings with overlapping objects, noise, and out-of-distribution tests, OrthoRF matches or outperforms current models while producing more interpretable representations, and it eliminates the post-hoc clustering required by many synchrony-based approaches. Unlike current models, OrthoRF also recovers occluded object parts, indicating stronger grouping under occlusion. Overall, orthogonality emerges as a simple, effective inductive bias for synchrony-based object-centric learning.
blocks.zh: 神经同步被假设为帮助大脑将视觉场景组织成结构化的多对象表现. 在机器学习中,基于同步的模型类似地通过在复杂价值特性的相相中存储绑定来学习以对象为中心的表示. 旋转地物 (RF) 即时将这个想法与矢量值活化,编码对象在量子上的存在和从属性在取向上存在. 我们提出正交旋转地物(正交地物),通过内出产损失和建筑改造在RF的取向空间中执行正交地物. 这会产生更尖锐相接和更可靠的分组。 在对无监督对象发现的评价中,包括有重叠对象的设置,噪声,以及分流外测试,OrthorF匹配或优于当前模型,同时产生更可解释的表示,它消除了许多以同步为基础的方法所需要后分集. 与目前的模型不同,OrthorF还回收了被吞噬的物体部分,表明被吞噬下更强的分组. 总的来说,正交现象是作为一个简单,有效的诱导偏差而出现的,用于以同步为基础的以对象为中心的学习.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Decomposing scenes into constituent parts is a long-standing strategy in computer vision. Classical approaches factorized images into surfaces and objects with properties like reflectance, albedo, and geometry ( Coakley, 2003 ) . Deep learning has renewed this effort by learning structured representations ( Zhang et al., 2013 ; Dittadi, 2023 ) .
In practice, this is often operationalized as Object-Centric Learning (OCL) ( Greff et al., 2020 ) , where models discover modular, compositional object representations that support generalization and relational reasoning on many downstream visual tasks ( Ding et al., 2021 ; Bapst et al., 2019 ; Mandikal and Grauman, 2021 ) .

在实际操作中,这经常作为对象-子学习(OCL)(Greff等人,2020年)来操作,其中模型发现模块化,组成性对象表示,在许多下游视觉任务上支持泛化和关系推理(Ding等人,2021年); Bapst et al., 2019; Mandikal and Grauman, 2021). ) Bapst et al.

blocks.en: At its core, much like human perception ( Spelke, 1990 ) , OCL addresses the binding problem ( Roskies, 1999 ) : flexibly integrating features (such as color, shape, texture) into a unified perception. This view aligns with cognitive and neuroscientific accounts that posit neural synchrony ( Singer, 2007 ) as a key mechanism, whereby temporally synchronized oscillations bind distributed information into coherent objects (see Fig 1 ).
blocks.zh: 其核心与人类感知(Spelke,1990年)大相径庭,OCL处理约束性问题(Roskies,1999年):将特征(如颜色,形状,纹理)灵活地融合到统一感知中. 这种观点与假定神经同步(Singer,2007年)为关键机制的认知和神经科学说法一致,通过这种机制,时间同步的振荡将分布的信息捆绑在连贯的物体中(见图1)。

blocks.en: A dominant OCL design to binding uses a collection of discrete latent vectors, named ”slots“ ( Locatello et al., 2020 ) , each dedicated to the features of a single object. As slot-based methods evolve, radically new ideas are emerging in OCL, some of which are inspired by synchrony ( Mozer et al., 1991 ; Reichert and Serre, 2013 ) . In this less-explored paradigm, binding is expressed via the relative phases of complex-valued neural activations, with phase-space distances serving as an implicit relational metric between object instances. Recently, synchrony-based models ( Löwe et al., 2022 ; Gopalakrishnan et al., 2024 ; Miyato et al., 2024 ) have achieved unsupervised object discovery on synthetic and more naturalistic scenes, surpassing prior supervised approaches ( Mozer et al., 1991 ) .
blocks.zh: 主要的OCL装订设计使用一组名为“slots”的离散潜在矢量(Locella 等人,2020年),每个矢量都专用于单个物体的特征。 随着基于时间档方法的演进,OCL中正在出现全新的想法,其中一些来自同步(Mozer等人,1991年;Reichert和Serre,2013年). 在这个探讨较少的范式中,绑定通过复杂价值的神经激活的相对阶段来表示,相位空间距离作为物体实例之间的隐含关系度量. 最近,基于同步的模型(Löwe等人,2022年;Gopalakrishnan等人,2024年;Miyato等人,2024年)在合成和比较自然主义的场景上实现了不受监督的物体发现,超过了以前受监督的方法(Mozer等人,1991年)。

blocks.en:
Current state-of-the-art synchrony-based models, such as Complex-valued Autoencoders (CAE) ( Löwe et al., 2022 ) , use real-valued weights to process complex-valued activations, by sharing weights across the real and imaginary parts. In these models, magnitudes encode feature presence, whereas phases encode object affiliation. During training, they leverage the natural constructive/destructive interference through the addition of complex activations in every layer, promoting phase alignment for features of the same object and phase separation for different objects.
A related work, named Rotating Features (RF) ( Löwe et al., 2024a ) , replaces complex-valued with vector-valued (i.e., n n -dimensional) activations that rotate on a hypersphere, extending representational capacity beyond 2D complex planes. To (de)synchronize phases for object representation, these models use an additional inductive bias via a gating mechanism ( Reichert and Serre, 2013 ) that strengthens interactions among similarly oriented features and weakens those among dissimilarly oriented ones. However, this mechanism can be hard to interpret. To improve interpretability, Löwe et al. (2024b) introduced cosine binding, a more transparent alternative that is based on cosine similarity between activations. This, however, entails substantial memory overhead, since it requires computing and storing many similarities between inputs and intermediate outputs.
blocks.zh:
目前最先进的基于同步的模型,如复杂值自动编码器(CAE)(Löwe等人,2022年),通过在真实部分和想象部分之间共享权重,使用实值加权处理复杂值激活. 在这些模型中,星等编码特征存在,而相位编码对象属性. 在训练期间,它们通过在每一层增加复杂的激活,利用天然的建设性/破坏性干扰,促进同一物体的相位对齐和不同物体的相位分离。
一项相关的作品名为"旋转地物"(RF)(Löwe等人,2024a),它用矢量值(即n-维)的活化器取代了在超层上旋转的复杂值(即n-维),将代表能力扩展到2D复合飞机之外. 为了(去)使物体表示的阶段同步,这些模型通过一种调制机制(Reichert and Serre,2013年)使用了额外的诱导偏差,这种机制加强了类似方向特征之间的互动,削弱了不同方向特征之间的互动。 然而,这种机制可能难以解释。 为了提高可解释性,Löwe等人(2024年b)引入了余弦绑定,这是一种基于激活之间余弦相似性的更加透明的替代品. 然而,这需要大量的内存间接费用,因为它需要计算和储存投入和中间产出之间的许多相似之处。

blocks.en: Synchrony-based models have important limitations. Unlike slot-based methods, which yield discrete, object-aligned slots (one slot ≈ \approx one object), state-of-the-art synchrony-based models ( Löwe et al., 2022 ; Löwe et al., 2024a ; Stanić et al., 2023 ; Miyato et al., 2024 ; Gopalakrishnan et al., 2024 ) produce distributed representations. While this can be more flexible, it makes the output hard to use without extra machinery. In practice, they require post-hoc clustering in phase space to recover objects, grouping features by phase. This distributed coding also degrades performance in overlap regions: features from occluding objects become uncertain and drift farther from cluster centers ( Löwe et al., 2024a ) , complicating object assignment. As a result, evaluations of these models often exclude overlapping regions, potentially underrepresenting the regimes where robust binding is most needed.
blocks.zh: 基于同步的模型有重要的局限性. 与基于档位的方法不同,该方法产生离散的,与对象相配合的档位(一个档位 \\\\约一个对象),最先进的基于同步的模型(Löwe等人,2022年;Löwe等人,2024年a;Stanic等人,2023年;Miyato等人,2024年;Gopalakrishnan等人,2024年)产生分布式表示. 虽然这可以更加灵活,但这使得没有额外机械的输出难以使用. 在实际操作中,它们要求在相位空间进行后热分组以回收物体,按相位分组特征. 这种分布式编码还降低重叠区域的性能:占用物体的特性变得不确定,离集群中心更远的漂移(Löwe等人,2024a),使物体分配复杂化。 因此,对这些模式的评价往往排除了重叠区域,可能不足以代表最需要强有力约束力的制度。

blocks.en:
In this paper, we advance synchrony-based models, specifically the RF autoencoder ( Löwe et al., 2024a ) , by improving both interpretability and representational capacity. Motivated by evidence that orthogonality enhances efficiency and encourages disentanglement ( Ranasinghe et al., 2021 ) , we propose Orthogonal Rotating Features (OrthoRF), an RF extension that enforces orthogonal object encoding in the phase space. Our approach has two components: (i) a softmax-based competitive binding that drives n n -dimensional activations to specialize on distinct input components (objects), and (ii) an inner-product-based orthogonality loss that enforces a 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} separation between object representations in phase space. Together, these yield sharper phase alignment and more reliable grouping: features of the same object concentrate along a single vector dimension, producing one-hot–like object encodings.
In unsupervised object discovery evaluation, across scenarios with overlapping objects, noise, and out-of-distribution tests, OrthoRF matches or surpasses current methods, eliminates post-hoc clustering, and recovers occluded object parts in intermediate representations (a capability not shown by slot-based or prior synchrony-based models).
These results underscore orthogonality as a simple yet powerful inductive bias for synchrony-based object-centric learning.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们通过提高解释性和代表性能力,推进基于同步的模型,特别是RF自动编码器(Löwe等人,2024a)。 由于有证据表明矫形可以提高效率和鼓励分解(Ranasinghe等人,2021年),我们提议采用正交旋转特征(Orthoruf),即RF扩展法,在相位空间执行正交物体编码. 我们的方法有两个组成部分:(一)基于软马克思的竞争约束,驱动n维激活器专门处理不同的输入组件(对象),(二)基于内产物的矫形损失,强制在相位空间对物体表示进行90 ∘ 90^{\circ}的分离. 这些组合一起产生更尖端的相对和更可靠的组合:同一个对象的特征集中在一个单一的矢量维上,产生一热-类似对象的编码.
在无监督的物体发现评价中,在有重叠物体,噪声,以及分流外测试的假想中,OrthorF匹配或超越了当前方法,消除了荷克后集群,并回收中间代表物中被吞噬的物体部分(这种能力没有通过基于槽或先前同步模型显示).
这些结果强调矫形是同步对象中心学习的一种简单而强大的诱导偏差.

blocks.en: 3.1 Motivation
blocks.zh: 3.1 动机

blocks.en: Synchrony-based architectures such as RF ( Löwe et al., 2024a ) show that these n n -dimensional features can support object discovery, yet their representations are distributed (see Fig. 2 ) across dimensions, which in turn demands post-hoc clustering (e.g., k k -means) to recover objects. This dependence makes the pipeline fragile and less practical; a single object may occupy multiple dimensions, creating redundancy and blurring boundaries, particularly in overlap regions where features drift away from cluster centers (as noted by Löwe et al. (2024a) ) and assignments become uncertain. That uncertainty, however, carries informative cues: RF’s behavior in overlaps reveals occlusion signals that slot-based OCL methods ( Anciukevicius et al., 2020 ) seldom exploit. We investigate whether an architectural bias can preserve RF’s strengths while addressing these drawbacks. Guided by evidence that orthogonality sharpens discrimination and fosters disentanglement ( Lezama et al., 2018 ; Ranasinghe et al., 2021 ; Sun et al., 2017 ; Chen et al., 2020 ; Liu et al., 2018 ; Wang et al., 2018 ) , we impose orthogonality constraints in the RF orientation space so that each object collapses onto a single component in this n n -dimensional orientation space, reducing redundancy, removing the need for clustering, and converting overlap-driven uncertainty into a reliable cue for occlusion recovery.
blocks.zh: 基于同步的架构如RF(Löwe等人,2024a)显示,这些n-n-维特性可以支持对象的发现,然而它们的表达方式则在维度之间分布(见图2),这反过来又要求后hoc集群(如kk-means)来回收对象. 这种依赖性使管道变得脆弱和不切实际;单一物体可能具有多个维度,造成冗余和模糊边界,特别是在重叠区域,其特征从集群中心漂移(如Löwe等人(2024a)所指出)和任务变得不确定。 然而,这种不确定性带来了信息提示:RF在重叠中的行为揭示了隐蔽信号,即基于时间档的OCL方法(Anciukevicius等人,2020年)很少被利用。 我们调查建筑偏见能否在解决这些弊端的同时保持俄罗斯联邦的优势。 在有证据表明矫形会加剧歧视和助长脱色(Lezama等人,2018年;Ranasinghe等人,2021年;Sun等人,2017年;Chen等人,2020年;Liu等人,2018年;Wang等人,2018年)的指导下,我们在RF定向空间中施加矫形约束,使每个物体在此n维定向空间中坠落到单个组件上,减少冗余,消除集群需求,并将重叠驱动的不确定性转化为隔离恢复的可靠提示.

We also highlight key properties that emerge from these modifications. Fig. 2 illustrates the overall OrthoRF architecture.

We model object–component assignment as a discrete competition: each object should map to one component in the n n -dimensional orientation space. Inspired by multi-class classification, where a softmax layer maps logits to a categorical distribution, and by OCL methods such as Slot Attention (SA) ( Locatello et al., 2020 ) , we use the same mechanism to induce competition that drives object-oriented specialization across components.
In OrthoRF autoencoder, we apply a per-layer softmax over orientation components, yielding winner-take-most assignments and object-wise specialization.
To improve stability and prevent component collapse (e.g., all features mapped to one component while others are never used), we apply centering before the softmax, but only to the encoder’s output vectors. Empirically, this removes biases that would otherwise let a single component dominate ( Caron et al., 2021 ) . blocks.en:
We follow the evaluation protocol of Löwe et al. (2024a) ; Löwe et al. (2022) , benchmarking object discovery on datasets with varying numbers of geometric shapes. From RF, we use the 4Shapes dataset (binary variant), containing four object types placed at random locations with possible overlap. We choose the binary form due to RF’s reported sensitivity to color variation.
We also evaluate on MNIST&Shape ( Löwe et al., 2022 ) , pairing one MNIST digit with a randomly positioned geometric shape, and on the Shapes dataset of Miyato et al. (2024) , which contains 2–4 objects randomly sampled from four basic shape classes.
To assess performance in a more realistic domain, we introduce a synthetic SEM dataset of four stacked material layers, reflecting those used in semiconductor manufacturing, each containing repeated patterns from a single shape class. Layers are laterally shifted and heavily occlude each other. We provide clean and noisy variants to mimic SEM imaging conditions. This dataset emphasizes challenges such as occlusion, layer disentanglement, and robustness to noise. For additional dataset details, see the Appendix.

我们还对MNIST&Shape(Löwe等人,2022年)进行了评价,用随机定位的几何形状对一个MNIST数字进行配对,并对Miyato等人(2024年)的Shipes数据集进行了评价,其中包含从四个基本形状分类中随机抽样的2-4个对象.
为了在更现实的领域评估性能,我们引入了由四个堆叠材料层组成的合成SEM数据集,反映半导体制造中使用的,每个数据集包含来自单一形状类的重复图案. 层层横向转移,相互严重渗透. 我们提供干净而吵闹的变体来模仿SEM成像条件. 这个数据集强调隐蔽,层层脱落,强力噪声等挑战. 其他数据集详情见附录。

blocks.en: Following standard practices in object discovery, we evaluate performance using the Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) ( Hubert and Arabie, 1985 ; Rand, 1971 ; Greff et al., 2019 ) and Mean Best Overlap (MBO) ( Pont-Tuset et al., 2016 ; Seitzer et al., 2022 ) . ARI measures clustering similarity, ranging from 0 (chance) to 1 (perfect match). We compute it using decoder-predicted object masks against ground truth, either excluding background (ARI-BG) or including it (ARI+BG). MBO matches predicted and ground-truth masks by overlap and averages their Intersection-over-Union (IoU) scores.
blocks.zh: 按照发现物体的标准做法,我们使用调整后Rand指数(Hubert和Arabie, 1985年;兰德, 1971年;Greff等人,2019年)和Mean Best Overlap(MBO)(Pont-Tuset等人,2016年;Seitzer等人,2022年). ARI措施将相似性集中,从0(chance)到1(完美匹配)不等. 我们使用解码器预设的物体口罩对照地面真理进行计算,或者排除背景(ARI-BG),或者包括其(ARI+BG). MBO通过重叠与预测的和地面真实的口罩相匹配,并平均得出其跨节联盟(IoU)的分数.

blocks.en: The OrthoRF implementation follows RF ( Löwe et al., 2024a ) using a convolutional autoencoder. Architectural details appear in Table 9 and Table 10 (Appendix). The models were trained with Adam ( Kingma and Ba, 2015 ) using a batch size of 16 for 100-200k steps across different datasets, with a CosineAnnealingLR scheduler applied for learning-rate decay. Experiments were run in PyTorch ( Paszke et al., 2019 ) on a single NVIDIA Tesla T4 (16 GB). Additional training settings are listed in Table 11 (Appendix).

First, visible-only object discovery evaluates model outputs ( 𝐳 final \mathbf{z}_{\text{final}} for RF/OrthoRF) against ground-truth masks that exclude overlapping regions (as defined by Löwe et al. (2024a) ). Second, we evaluate shape completion using MBO i OV \mathrm{MBO}^{\text{OV}}_{\text{i}} , which measures full-object recovery—including overlapping (OV) regions—by comparing predictions to instance-level ground-truth masks (labeling scheme in Appendix B.3 ).
In Table 1 , we first report RF’s 𝐳 final \mathbf{z}_{\text{final}} using its standard post-processing (output normalization, magnitude masking, and k k -means). We then apply the same post-processing to OrthoRF’s 𝐳 final \mathbf{z}_{\text{final}} for a fair comparison. Finally, we evaluate OrthoRF’s intermediate map ψ final \psi_{\text{final}} —the gating mechanism’s intermediate representation in the output layer—by thresholding it at 0.1 (see Appendix B.4 for details), without any additional post-processing, to obtain binarized masks for metric computation. Table 2 reports visible-only object discovery results for OrthoRF, RF, and two non-neural baselines, k k -means and a histogram-based method, on clean and noisy SEM datasets. For k k -means, we use scikit-learn’s implementation to cluster pixel intensities. The histogram baseline uses mode/peak assignment (nearest-peak clustering); in the intensity histogram, we detect prominent peaks, and assign each pixel to the closest peak.
These non-neural baselines were chosen because they are unsupervised, fast, and interpretable. They also show how much segmentation is possible from intensity alone on uniform-color SEM shapes, without heavy architectures, or additional training.
Both OrthoRF and RF use n = 5 n=5 (4 object layers + + background) dimensionality in the orientation space.

Table 2 shows that OrthoRF outperforms RF on both the noise-free (ARI-BG: 0.9908 vs 0.9551) and the noisy test set (ARI-BG: 0.8356 vs 0.7043), indicating greater robustness under heavy occlusion and noise. Compared with k k -means and the histogram baseline, the neural models excel especially in noisy settings, where edge blurring potentially hinders intensity-only clustering.
We also evaluated out-of-distribution generalization for OrthoRF. Training on clean data and testing on noisy yields only a minor drop (ARI-BG from 0.9908 to 0.9836), indicating strong noise tolerance. In contrast, training on noisy data and testing on clean degrades more (from 0.8356 to 0.7610), likely because noise-trained models learn smoothed boundaries that underfit sharp, clean edges.

To assess the orthogonality constraint in the output z final z_{\text{final}} , we compute inter- and intra-cluster angular metrics following Stanić et al. (2023) . The inter-cluster metric measures separation between objects by computing unit-normalized centroids per object and evaluating pairwise centroid angles; angles near 90° indicate strong, orthogonal separation. The intra-cluster metric measures compactness by computing the angular deviation of each pixel feature from its object’s centroid. Metrics are computed per image and averaged over the 4Shapes dataset.
Table 7 shows that OrthoRF achieves consistently lower intra-cluster dispersion than RF, indicating tighter object representations. RF attains a higher mean inter-cluster angle, but with large variability (std. ≈ \approx 23.57°), suggesting unstable separation. In contrast, OrthoRF produces near-orthogonal inter-cluster angles with substantially lower variance.

blocks.en: 5 Related work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en:
Over the years, a wide range of OCL models ( Eslami et al., 2016 ; Greff et al., 2016 ; greff2017neural ; Jiang et al., 2019 ; Lin et al., 2020 ; Prabhudesai et al., 2022 ; Stelzner et al., 2019 ) have been proposed. MONet ( Burgess et al., 2019 ) , IODINE ( Greff et al., 2019 ) , and GENESIS ( Engelcke et al., 2019 ; Engelcke et al., 2021 ) propose unsupervised approaches to disentangle scenes into objects, with MONet and IODINE modeling objects independently and GENESIS capturing their interactions. SA ( Locatello et al., 2020 ) extends this line of work by introducing an iterative attention mechanism where slots compete to bind to distinct objects.
This design has inspired numerous extensions, including SLATE ( Singh et al., 2021 ) and DINOSAUR ( Seitzer et al., 2022 ) , which integrate Transformer-based encoders and decoders ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) to better handle real-world images.
OCL has been extended to both 3D ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Sajjadi et al., 2022 ; Stelzner et al., 2021 ) and video data ( Lai et al., 2021 ; Elsayed et al., 2022 ; Singh et al., 2022 ) . ROOTS ( Chen et al., 2021 ) disentangles objects via 3D-to-2D multi-view projections, while SAVi ( Lai et al., 2021 ) , SAVi++ ( Elsayed et al., 2022 ) , and STEVE ( Singh et al., 2022 ) extend SA to videos, leveraging temporal dynamics to separate objects from each other and the background. Similarly, PathTracker ( Linsley et al., 2021 ) disentangles objects via trajectory-based grouping, and its extension FeatureTracker ( Muzellec et al., 2024 ) further separates in feature and color space.
blocks.zh:
多年来,提出了多种OCL模型(Eslami等人,2016年;Greff等人,2016年;greff2017neural;Jiang等人,2019年;Lin等人,2020年;Prabhudesai等人,2022年;Stelzner等人,2019年). MONet(Burgess等人,2019年),IODINE(Greff等人,2019年),和GENESSIS(Engelcke等人,2019年;Engelcke等人,2021年)提出了将场景分散成物体的不受监督的方法,MONet和IODINE对物体进行独立模拟,GENESIS捕捉它们的相互作用. SA(Locello等人,2020年)扩展了这一条工作线,引入了一种迭代关注机制,使槽竞争与不同的物体结合。
这种设计启发了众多的扩展,包括SLATE(Singh等人,2021年)和DINOSAUR(Seitzer等人,2022年),它们融合了基于变形器的编码器和解码器(Vaswani等人,2017年),以便更好地处理现实世界的图像.
OCL已扩展至3D(Chen等人,2021年;Sajjadi等人,2022年;Stelzner等人,2021年)和视频数据(Lai等人,2021年;Elsayed等人,2022年;Singh等人,2022年). ROOTS(Chen等人,2021年)通过3D对2D多视图投影对物体进行疏导,而SAVi(Lai等人,2021年),SAVi++(Elsayed等人,2022年),STEVE(Singh等人,2022年)则将SA扩展为视频,利用时间动态将物体与背景区分开来. 同样,PathTracker(Linsley等人,2021年)通过基于轨迹的分组来解开物体,其扩展的FeatureTracker(Muzellec等人,2024年)在特征和色彩空间上进一步分离.

blocks.en:
Recent OCL works ( Löwe et al., 2022 ; Reichert and Serre, 2013 ; Löwe et al., 2024a ; Stanić et al., 2024 ) move beyond slot-based models, inspired by neuroscience.
While early studies utilized supervised ( Mozer et al., 1991 ) or weakly supervised ( Ravishankar Rao and Cecchi, 2010 ) settings, modern methods emphasize unsupervised discovery. CAE ( Löwe et al., 2022 ) uses complex-valued activations for phase clustering, a framework recently extended via contrastive losses in CtCAE ( Stanić et al., 2024 ) or higher-dimensional rotations in RF ( Löwe et al., 2024a ) . Unlike these models where synchrony emerges dynamically, other works ( Miyato et al., 2024 ; Muzellec et al., 2025 ) enforce phase synchrony through explicit synchronizers (e.g., Kuramoto oscillators).
blocks.zh:
最近OCL的作品(Löwe等人,2022年;Reichert and Serre,2013年;Löwe等人,2024年a;Stanić等人,2024年)超越了基于槽的模型,受到神经科学的启发.
虽然早期研究被监督(Mozer等人,1991年)或弱监督(Ravishankar Rao和Cecchi,2010年),但现代方法强调无监督的发现。 CAE(Löwe等人,2022年)利用复杂值的激活进行相聚,这是最近在CtCAE(Stanić等人,2024年)或RF(Löwe等人,2024年a)中通过对比性损失扩展的框架。 与同步动态出现的这些模型不同,其他作品(Miyato等人,2024年;Muzellec等人,2025年)通过明确同步器(如仓本振荡器)执行相同步.

blocks.en: Orthogonality has been widely exploited in deep learning. It has been used in network initialization ( Saxe et al., 2013 ) and during training ( Achour et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2019 ) to improve stability and generalization. Orthogonality also has been used to create discriminative feature representations ( Lezama et al., 2018 ; Ranasinghe et al., 2021 ) and disentangle features ( Wang et al., 2018 ) . In open-world object detection ( Sun et al., 2024 ) , a study utilized multiple levels of orthogonality throughout the training process to mitigate catastrophic interference and facilitate incremental learning of previously unseen objects.
blocks.zh: 矫形学在深入学习中被广泛利用. 它被用于网络初始化(Saxe等人,2013年)和培训期间(Achour等人,2022年;Li等人,2019年),以提高稳定性和普及性. 矫形还被用于创建歧视性特征表述(Lezama等人,2018年;Ranasinghe等人,2021年)和分散特征(Wang等人,2018年). 在开放世界物体探测(Sun等人,2024年)中,一项研究在整个训练过程中利用了多种水平的矫形,以减轻灾难性干扰,并促进对以前未见物体的渐进学习。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce the OrthoRF autoencoder to address a central RF ( Löwe et al., 2024a ) limitation: distributed object-centric representations break down in overlaps, where features from different objects become uncertain and undermine phase-space clustering. OrthoRF couples competitive binding with an inner-product orthogonality loss to align each object to a distinct phase axis, yielding sharper alignment and removing the clustering step. Across unsupervised object discovery OrthoRF matches or surpasses relevant models and recovers occluded parts. More broadly, orthogonality provides an effective inductive bias that regularizes distributed representations into discrete, directly resolving overlap ambiguity and improving the downstream usability.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们引入了OrthoRF自编码器,以解决RF(Löwe等人,2024a)中枢限制:分布式的以物体为中心的表达方式在重叠中分解,不同物体的特征变得不确定,并破坏了相位集群. OrthorF夫妇具有内产物矫形损失的竞争性约束,使每个物体都与一个明显的相位轴对齐,产生更尖锐的对齐,并去掉集群步骤. 纵观无监督的物体发现 OrthorF 匹配或超过相关模型,并回收被占用的部分. 更广泛地说,矫形是一种有效的诱导性偏差,它使分布式表述规范化为离散,直接解决重叠的模糊性,提高下游的可用性.

blocks.en:
OrthoRF converges more slowly than RF ( ≈ \approx 200k vs. ≈ \approx 100k steps), due to its stricter object discovery and separation objective. Rarely, training can get stuck in suboptimal states (incomplete separation or multi-object collapse onto one phase axis), a phenomenon also noted in slot-based setups ( Locatello et al., 2020 ) . Increasing λ \lambda or lowering the learning rate stabilizes training.
Future research will explore integrating synchrony-based binding into attention mechanisms, mitigating RF’s performance degradation on RGB datasets, and extending evaluations to video and realistic datasets. To offset the computational cost of vector-valued ”lifting,“ we aim to explore more parameter-efficient encodings. Furthermore, inspired by Extreme Image Transforms (EIT) ( Crowder and Malik, 2022 ; Malik et al., 2023 ) , exploring EIT-based augmentations and severe corruptions (e.g., salt-and-pepper noise) remains a promising direction for enhancing robustness.
blocks.zh:
OrthorF的聚合速度比RF慢(QQ\约200k vs. QX\约100k步),因为其更严格的对象发现和分离目标. 很少,训练可能停留在不理想状态(分离不完全或多对象崩溃到一个相轴上),这种现象在基于槽的设置中也注意到(Locallo等人,2020年)。 增加 \\ lambda 或降低学习率稳定了培训。
未来的研究将探索将基于同步的绑定纳入关注机制,减缓RF在RGB数据集上的性能退化,并将评价扩展到视频和现实的数据集. 为了抵消“提高矢量值”的计算成本,“我们的目标是探索更具参数效率的编码。 此外,受极端图像转变(EIT)的启发(Crowder和Malik, 2022年;Malik等人, 2023年),探索基于经济转型期的增强和严重腐败(如盐和酸性噪音),仍然是加强稳健性的一个有希望的方向。

blocks.en: Thresholding is used as a simple post-processing step to binarize the model’s output for metric computation. The ψ \psi -thresholding procedure is largely insensitive to the choice of threshold. As illustrated in Figs. 10 , we first discard background channels (i.e., feature maps with very low variance) and then apply a fixed threshold to the remaining maps. Because competitive binding creates a strong separation between active and inactive regions, a wide range of thresholds produces nearly identical binarizations; 0.1 serves as a convenient default, though other values yield similarly strong results. An adaptive, statistically motivated thresholding scheme is a natural extension for future work.
